mole-depth-atlas.png.prompt: Create a production-ready transparent PNG sprite atlas for a tiny house-cleaning game. Reference image is ONLY the exact character identity and soft miniature 3D rendering style to match. Same cute dark chocolate-brown mole, tiny pink nose/paws, no clothes, holding the identical wooden broom with pale straw bristles. Create the MISSING FRONT and BACK directions, not left/right profiles. Exact 2:1 canvas, 4 equal columns x 2 equal rows, eight equal square cells, no labels, no grid lines. TOP ROW: character facing AWAY from viewer, walking north/up into the house, show back of head and rounded back, face and nose not visible. BOTTOM ROW: character facing TOWARD viewer, walking south/down out of house, symmetrical face, small centered nose, two eyes visible. Camera remains slightly elevated like the reference so the top of the head and feet are visible, no change of camera between frames. In EACH ROW columns are: 1 standing idle holding broom upright; 2 walking stride A one foot forward; 3 walking stride B opposite foot forward; 4 sweeping at end of a broom stroke. All character bodies same scale, centered horizontally in their cells, feet contact point at exactly 86% cell height, character top around 18% cell height. Leave generous transparent margins around every mole and the entire broom, nothing cut off and no objects crossing cell boundaries. Keep broom visible at character side when facing away. Background must be genuine transparent alpha, no ground plane, no beige background, no checkerboard, no text, no dust, no cast shadow beyond feet. Precisely aligned consistent character animation sheet, soft warm lighting, refined sculpted fur matching reference.

dust-puff.png.prompt: Generate one small isolated dust puff VFX sprite for a cozy miniature 3D house-cleaning animation. Square transparent PNG. A low horizontal wisp of warm muted taupe and sand-colored dust gently fanning out from a broom stroke, three or four tiny loosely clustered soft dusty curls and a few fine scattered specks, airy rather than opaque smoke, delicate feathered alpha edges. Softly sculpted miniature illustration, quiet warm colors, visible on both cream and charcoal backgrounds. Puff width about 70% of the square, height about 28%, positioned centered horizontally and just below the vertical center. Leave all surrounding area genuinely transparent. No broom, no character, no house, no floor plane, no backdrop, no shadow rectangle, no text, no sparkles, no bright white fog, no cartoon black outlines. This will be rendered at only about 25px wide and animated by native translation, scale and opacity.
